title: Bear and String Distance
statementMd:
Limak is a little polar bear. He likes **nice** strings — strings of length $*n*$, consisting of lowercase English letters only.

The distance between two letters is defined as the difference between their positions in the alphabet. For example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b94160a4d1c955e1b6cd4a0fe139f103c35ac73f.png), and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7a05c5ca27b2dc782643b883e8a0bae7e3298e4f.png).

Also, the distance between two nice strings is defined as the sum of distances of corresponding letters. For example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/77f313bb7e669a438377b73e0dcdc89dc88f4a7a.png), and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51de79586a12d9aa6a55105517514bcd173984a8.png).

Limak gives you a nice string $*s*$ and an integer $*k*$. He challenges you to find any nice string $*s*'$ that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/586a7bce2dc944b81b116fca51344694db717b8b.png). Find any $*s*'$ satisfying the given conditions, or print "`-1`" if it's impossible to do so.

As input/output can reach huge size it is recommended to use fast input/output methods: for example, prefer to use `gets/scanf/printf` instead of `getline/cin/cout` in C++, prefer to use `BufferedReader/PrintWriter` instead of `Scanner/System.out` in `Java`.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$).

The second line contains a string $*s*$ of length $*n*$, consisting of lowercase English letters.

## Output

If there is no string satisfying the given conditions then print "`-1`" (without the quotes).

Otherwise, print any nice string $*s*'$ that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/586a7bce2dc944b81b116fca51344694db717b8b.png).
statementZhMd:
Limak 是一只小北极熊。他喜欢**美好**字符串——长度为 $*n*$、且只由小写英文字母组成的字符串。

两个字母之间的距离定义为它们在字母表中的位置之差。例如，[图片](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b94160a4d1c955e1b6cd4a0fe139f103c35ac73f.png)，以及[图片](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7a05c5ca27b2dc782643b883e8a0bae7e3298e4f.png)。

两个美好字符串之间的距离定义为对应位置上的字母距离之和。例如，[图片](https://espresso.codeforces.com/77f313bb7e669a438377b73e0dcdc89dc88f4a7a.png)，以及[图片](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51de79586a12d9aa6a55105517514bcd173984a8.png)。

Limak 给你一个美好字符串 $*s*$ 和一个整数 $*k*$。他要求你找出任意一个满足[图片](https://espresso.codeforces.com/586a7bce2dc944b81b116fca51344694db717b8b.png)的美好字符串 $*s*'$。请找出任意满足条件的 $*s*'$；如果无法做到，则输出 "`-1`"。

由于输入输出规模可能很大，建议使用快速输入输出方法：例如，在 C++ 中优先使用 `gets/scanf/printf`，而不是 `getline/cin/cout`；在 Java 中优先使用 `BufferedReader/PrintWriter`，而不是 `Scanner/System.out`。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$）。

第二行包含一个长度为 $*n*$、仅由小写英文字母组成的字符串 $*s*$。

## 输出格式

如果不存在满足条件的字符串，则输出 "`-1`"（不含引号）。

否则，输出任意一个满足[图片](https://espresso.codeforces.com/586a7bce2dc944b81b116fca51344694db717b8b.png)的美好字符串 $*s*'$。
